features.title: TokenizerSet — the bench, all coordinates, self-validating
features.notes: scenes/tokenizer_set.py. Seven bays on one left-to-right line plus a consequence spur. validate() re-derives every figure from the drawn mobjects: two routing assertions over paths joined from the drawn rails, four bay-separation checks, the character row against the shot it is read in, the payload-is-one-list check, the zoom budget (59.93 against SHOT_WIDE=60, 0.1% off), an explicit assertion that the pull-back frame clears the bottom of the meter bay, a typography.audit of every pull-back label, and a check that the shrunken bench fits INSIDE the ghost node.

features.title: CharacterRow, MergeTable, VocabWall, GhostCircuit
features.notes: scenes/props.py. LOCAL, and staying local: none has a second consumer, so the AGENTS.md promotion rule says they do not go in /lib yet. CharacterRow is the likeliest future promotion (the Forcing JSON episode is the same character/token mismatch) and gets a structural test at that moment, not before.

features.title: Tokenization — the seven-beat continuous shot
features.notes: scenes/scene_tokenization.py. 59.50s nominal, measured under the 60.0s cap at `final`. One beat method per beat, each carrying its target timecode. Five token-accounting assertions, module level and in-beat.

features.title: SlidesTokenization — the click deck
features.notes: 45 animations -> 40 stops, total 59.500000s, one suppressed region (B3's runaway merge list, a ramp). Copies no timing. Shortest chunk 0.70s, so no stop is a single frame at any profile.
